text:
tara: Urgent — customer demo hit intermittent 429s on /v1/embeddings around minute 2 of the script, demo paused.

ben: Ugh. Any error body or headers? likely per-route cap or token budget.

tara: Pasting the client error: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: rq_demo_77
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Token-Budget: 0/300
{
  "error": "token_budget_exhausted",
  "message": "per-route token budget exceeded for tenant: zephyr-poc"
}
```

lee: That X-Token-Budget header nails it. Sales set a small per-route tokens=300/min for isolation; their load is 80 concurrent embedding calls of 5-10 tokens each so it burns fast.

saqib: Quick options: 1) Temp bump per-route reservation, 2) ask client to add exponential backoff + jitter, 3) reduce concurrency / increase batch size. For an immediate fix, we can do a short reservation.

tara: We need it unblocked in next 8 minutes. Can someone apply a 900 token reservation for 8 minutes? Also grab audit logs (request ids + token_count breakdown) for postmortem.

ben: @quota-bot reserve: tenant=zephyr-poc delta=900 duration=480s reason="live presales demo"

quota-bot: Request acknowledged. Applying temporary reservation (may take ~15s). :hourglass: 

quota-bot: Done — reserved_tokens=900 expires_in=480s for tenant=zephyr-poc. Finance notified. :white_check_mark:

tara: Confirmed on the demo call — no more 429s after reservation. Thanks! :tada:

lee: Follow-up action items: - update presales runbook with how to request reservations and expected billing impact - recommend client-side concurrency cap (<=10 parallel) and batch size >=16 to reduce token pressure - consider bumping their steady per-route cap if usage stable - add a short-lived monitoring dashboard showing X-Token-Budget per-tenant so PMs can spot drains earlier

saqib: I'll pull the token accounting logs (request_id, model, token_count, route, ts) and upload to the deal tracker. Also will propose a default demo reservation policy to avoid last-minute escalations.

tara: Please include the exact CLI commands for sales to run quick bumps in the runbook. I'll ping legal about billing disclosure for temporary reservations.

ben: Nice rescue. Let's also include a snippet in the SDK docs showing how to implement retry-with-jitter for bulk embeddings.

tara: Attaching the minimal logs from the session for the postmortem. Closing thread after runbook draft posted. :thumbsup:
